nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; guards init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances modified in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spend allowances, updated in approve and transferFrom.
Private counter of sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private whitelist mapping of addresses allowed to sell, read in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount set in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount set in init and enforced in condition.
Private max number of sales per address set in init and enforced in condition.
Whitelisted trade address set by setTradeAddress and read in ensure.
Public total supply minted to owner in constructor.
Constant 18 used to scale amounts in constructor and init.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address compared against in ensure and granted infinite allowance in constructor.
External payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist check using owner, tradeAddress, UNI, computed pair and canSale before falling back to condition.
External payable transfer that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum without a reentrancy guard.
External payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing a raw delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only initialization of sale limits using unguarded multiplication and exponentiation.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor assigning owner, initial supply, balances and infinite UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance checks, ownership and balance credit.
Raw delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address enabling storage takeover.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value allowing allowance underflow.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and unchecked balanceOf subtraction in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) in init.

edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender controls the allowance lookup and the caller identity check in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from, _to, _value) before state mutation.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner privileged address.
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping to bypass sale checks.
ensure compares _from against the owner-set tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure derives the pair address via pairFor for the whitelist comparison.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales per address.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale limit.
condition enforces the configured _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the configured _maxSale upper bound.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorize the spend.
transferFrom debits and credits balanceOf entries for both parties.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after moving balances.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no validation.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
init writes the computed minimum sale amount into _minSale.
init writes the computed maximum sale amount into _maxSale.
init writes the supplied saleNum into _saleNum.
init scales token amounts by 10**decimals.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing tokens.
batchSend debits msg.sender balance and credits each recipient balance.
setTradeAddress assigns an arbitrary address to the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting all privileged functions.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
constructor computes totalSupply from the supply parameter and decimals.
constructor grants infinite allowance over the UNI router address.
constructor uses the UNI constant as the infinite-allowance spender.
constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals.
constructor stores the token name.
constructor stores the token symbol.
delegate performs a raw delegatecall to an attacker-influenced address.
delegate is gated only by the msg.sender == owner check.
msg.sender is compared against owner to authorize the delegatecall.
msg.sender is compared against owner for init authorization.
msg.sender is compared against owner and used as the debited balance holder in batchSend.
msg.sender is compared against owner in setTradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes the owner and initial balance holder in the constructor.
the _from derived from msg.sender drives whitelist and condition decisions in ensure.
transferFrom decrements allowance without SafeMath, permitting allowance underflow.
the _value parameter feeds the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend computes total via unchecked multiplication and subtracts it unchecked.
init multiplies user-supplied values by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
transfer forwards its recipient parameter to transferFrom.
transfer forwards its value parameter to transferFrom.
transferFrom uses its _from parameter for allowance and balance lookups.
transferFrom uses its _to parameter to credit the destination balance.
transferFrom uses its _value parameter to move balances.
approve stores the allowance keyed by the _spender parameter.
approve stores the allowance amount from the _value parameter.
ensure evaluates the _from parameter against whitelists and condition.
ensure evaluates the _to parameter against the owner check.
ensure passes the _value parameter into condition.
condition indexes _onSaleNum with the _from parameter.
condition compares the _value parameter against _minSale and _maxSale.
delegate takes the delegatecall target from the _a parameter.
delegate uses the _b parameter as the delegatecall calldata.
user-supplied calldata is executed in the contract storage context via delegatecall.
init writes the saleNum parameter into _saleNum.
init scales the token parameter into _minSale.
init scales the maxToken parameter into _maxSale.
batchSend iterates the _tos recipient array.
batchSend uses the _value parameter as the per-recipient amount.
the _value parameter is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow checking.
setTradeAddress writes the caller-supplied addr into the whitelist slot.
constructor stores the name parameter.
constructor stores the symbol parameter.
constructor multiplies the supply parameter by 10**decimals to form totalSupply.
the local total derived from unchecked multiplication is used for the balance subtraction.
the loop index i drives iteration over the recipient array.
each loop recipient _to is credited via balanceOf[_to] += _value.
